notes.title: Solaris Showdown Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999092/354f840895d2cef47d6bd34ffc31c6e30b5c877b.jpg
GREETINGS MERCENARIES!

We hope you're enjoying the return of the Legendary Voice of Solaris, Duncan Fisher, as much as we are! To keep the good times rolling along, as we’re sure Duncan would prefer, here are a bunch of bug fixes and updates to make Solaris Showdown even more fun, enjoyable, and achievable!

-The MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries Team

What: There is a patch planned for MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries Solaris Showdown
When: Tuesday, March 26th, 5pm PST / Wednesday, March 27th 12am UTC
 

GAMEPLAY

 Updated the Loaderking and Gladiator 'Mech variants so they can be salvaged
 Increased the rate of which the COR-LZ and LDK-IDM would spawn in Markets
 Fixed a bug where dealing damage to destroyed 'Mechs would count towards Arena optional objectives
 Added Additional ammo to the Solaris Showdown Career Start
 Fixed a bug where negotiation points would reset if you made a work order after setting them

 

BATTLEMECHS
Added special geometry to the following Gladiator 'Mechs:

 UM-SA1
 HBK-VEST
 ZEU-SA3
 COR-LZ
 LDK-IDM


 Fixed an issue where the Loaderking’s feet would disconnect when destroyed


WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

 Increased the range of the Medium Lance to 20m (from 18)
 Fixed an arm clipping issue with the Lance when equipped to the KTO-18P and TBT-5P
 Fixed an issue where Solaris Showdown weapons would appear in rare markets if the user did not own DLC6


MAPS AND MISSIONS

 Updated the final repair bay in Showdown in Steiner Stadium to be able to repair 'Mechs
 Moved the player spawn point of Scrapyard Scuffle arena missions
 Adjusted arena announcer lines so the mission end lines will play more frequently
 Adjusted arena announcer behavior so enemy-destroyed lines would play more frequently
 Fix several bugs on arena procedural missions where an enemy 'Mech was missing
 Adjusted the timing of the spawn pen doors opening for Solaris Showdown campaign missions
 Fixed instances where Duncan’s 'Mech can be stuck inside the spawn pen in Ticket to Solaris
 Fixed a bug in Arena free-for-all missions where co-op spectators would trigger the “Too many 'Mechs: Enemies Grouping Up” event
 Adjusted the timing of the ending dialogue in Showdown in Steiner Stadium
 Fixed issues where some 'Mechs can get stuck inside geo on Steiner Stadium
 Fixed issues with floating geometry on Boreal Reach
 Fixed an issue where it was able to rain inside on Ishiyama Caves and 'Mech Factory
 Added Arena missions to Instant Action
 Free-for-All, Duel, Lance Duel, Pairs, and Exhibition variants are available

 

AI

 Adjusted the starting spawn pens in Solaris Showdown Campaign missions so AI allies are less likely to get stuck
 Adjusted the rate of enemy focus on the player in Let the Games Begin
 Adjusted the behavior of enemies to be more active on FFA arena missions
 Fixed a bug in Arena missions where enemies would sometimes remain defending their spawn locations

 

MISC

 Fixed a bug where music would not play during Solaris Arena procedural missions
 Fixed an issue with controllers not being able to properly scroll on the Downloadable content menu
 Fixed an issue in the editor where HomeMenuPanelWidget would be in an infinite loop
 Adjusted Cinematic subtitle timing
 Fixed an issue where the wrong Scrapyard image was being used on the Biome banner
 Fixed an issue in Hardcore Hurdles, Ticket to Solaris and Showdown at Steiner Stadium where dying during the opening dialogue sequences would not bring up the Game Over screen
 Added Arena missions to Instant Action with Free-for-All, Duel, Lance Duel, Pairs and Exhibition variants
 Added special geometry to the following Arena Gladiator 'Mechs: UM-SA1, HBK-VEST, ZEU-SA3, COR-LZ, LDK-IDM
 Updated the Gladiator and Loaderking variants so they can be salvaged
 Adjusted be behavior of enemies to be more active on FFA arena missions
 Fixed an issue in Hardcore Hurdles, Ticket to Solaris and Showdown at Steiner Stadium where dying during the opening dialogue sequences would not bring up the Game Over screen
 Increased the range of the Medium Lance to 20m
 Adjusted the starting spawn pens in DLC6 Campaign missions so AI allies would be less likely to get stuck
 Fix bugs where certain arena announcer lines that did not play
 Fix several bugs on arena procedural missions where an enemy 'Mech was missing
 Added the Cooldown Percentage and Range Percentage quirk to Medium Burst Fire Rifles
 Fixed a bug in Arena FFA missions where co-op spectators would trigger the “Too many 'Mechs: Enemies Grouping Up” event
 Adjusted the rate of enemy focus on the player in Let the Games Begin
 Increased the rate of which the COR-LZ and LDK-IDM would spawn in Markets
 Fixed a bug where negotiation points would reset if you made a work order after setting them
 Fixed an issue where it was able to rain inside on Ishiyama Caves and 'Mech Factory

notes.title: MW5 MERCS DRAGON'S GAMBIT MINOR PATCH #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999092/b6d163a0580d6eae5f6cb8d0921da2990cda1dd9.jpg

Greetings Mercenaries,
Thank you so much for all the positive responses and valuable feedback you have sent in for The Dragon's Gambit!  We're excited to fill you in on another batch of fixes to smooth out your gameplay experience.  This patch was released Oct 25th at 5 PM PST so your game should have automatically applied the update. We wanted to let you know what fixes were addressed in the latest patch:


 FIXED! - PS4s will no longer black screen freeze when traveling to the second mission in Dragon's Gambit
 FIXED! - Difficulty no longer resets with a game reboot on consoles
 FIXED! - Damaged Mechs with load-outs from the Olesko mission no longer appear in procedural missions
 FIXED! - Instant Action - DLC5 campaign missions now show up in Instant Action after completing it in campaign/career mode.
 FIXED! - Medium Rifle tuning fixes - Incorrect damage values at higher tiers Medium rifles above tier 1 had the +damage quirk instead of +damage percent quirk, resulting in bonuses of .05, .1, .2, and .3 damage, instead of intended 5%, 10%, 20%, and 30% bonuses in line with other classes of the rifle.
 FIXED! - Faction standing - Comstar faction standing will no longer be -400 if the player loads a campaign save file that has a game date past 3039 - The Comstar faction fix only applies to saves that have not yet loaded past 3039, saves that already have the -400 cant be changed


If you have further issues with MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries or any of the DLC please contact us at support@mw5mercs.com and we will do our best to address the issues!

The MechWarrior 5 Mercenaires Team

notes.title: MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries - Game Update Details
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999092/983ef70471c660ed3b205b824d1d7a4505c80c43.jpg
Greetings Mercenaries!

Piranha Games is very excited about the upcoming release of our fourth DLC for MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries, Rise of Rasalhague. Arriving January 26th, this DLC will also include a Free Game Update that includes a variety of significant improvements to AI performance and behavior, as well as many quality of life improvements that will make the gameplay experience even more enjoyable for our players.

Here are the key features in the Free Game Update:

VARIOUS SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENTS TO AI PERFORMANCE AND BEHAVIOR


 Lancemates will follow issued commands more consistently
 Lancemates will no longer become unresponsive after ‘Mech switching
 AI targeting now more consistent
 AI will fire more frequently
 AI will fire LRMs more frequently
 Lancemates no longer get stuck inside the dropship
 Friendly AI no longer walk through buildings and structures in Defense missions (friendly-fire may still occur with missed weapons fire)
 Enemy AI will avoid walking through buildings and structures on Demolitions missions
 AI will no longer walk backwards towards targets for no reason
 AI will no longer incorrectly overheat when firing weapons that fire multiple projectiles per shot (ie. SRMs)

 

REDESIGNED 'MECH HANGAR ALLOWING YOU TO EXPAND YOUR ACTIVE 'MECH ROSTER


 Active 'Mech roster now expandable from 12 to 40 'Mech Bays
 Dropship has four ‘Mechbays
 Additional active ‘Mechbays may be leased for a quarterly fee per additional ‘Mechbay
 The first eight additional bays will have their quarterly costs highly subsidized by Interstellar Expeditions
 You may lease up to 36 additional active ‘Mechbays, for a total of 40 available
 All ‘Mechs stored in active ‘Mechbays are eligible for mission deployment and receiving repair orders

 

MANY QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS MAKING THE GAMEPLAY EXPERIENCE EVEN MORE ENJOYABLE


 Improvements to the Ready Up UI in Co-op make it easier to see lance ready status
 Avoid friendly fire with a new audio cue
 Stay informed with the ability to view details of set work orders
 Moved Faction info into a separate tab, and condensed the ‘Mech database stats
 Divided the Star System information on the View Intel screen
 There's more to see now with Spectators in Co-op mode now able to view mission objectives and the minimap
 You’ll know they’ve heard with added UI feedback when giving lancemate commands
 Gain a better understanding with added UI feedback for bonus or reduced negotiation points due to faction reputation
 Try something new with the added first-person, conventional shooter controls-style mode for gamepad, keyboard and mouse

 

We're confident that these improvements will enhance the overall gameplay experience, and we’re excited for you to try them out! Thank you for your support, and we’ll continue to listen to your feedback. See you on the battlefield!

 

The MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries Team

notes.title: MechWarrior 5 Launch Day Intel
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999092/3aaa2ea50b6abed43fcd4626bbc2ed25b4d0a682.jpg

Greetings Mercenaries!

Welcome to our MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries and Heroes of the Inner Sphere Launch Day post!  In this post, you will find all the latest information and updates to keep you informed. As with every launch, there is some last-minute information that comes up that we want to relay to players. We will keep this post updated for the coming weeks to keep this information current!

Here is the current intel:

Release Time

The Date and time of release is May 27th at 00:00 UTC. This means the game should be available on Steam,  May 26th at 5 PM Pacific Daylight Time

Products


 MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries with the Year one Update is $29.99 USD
 MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Heroes of the Inner Sphere is $19.99 USD
 We are also releasing MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries - Digital Extras for $4.99 USD
 MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries Dropship Collection $49.99 USD
 Featuring MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries, Heroes of the Inner Sphere, and Digital Extras


Infantry

As part of our Free Year One Update, we have had infantry present in the game for quite some time. After careful consideration, we decided to keep this feature as a Mod instead of a Feature. While infantry added ambient life it didn't reach our intended goals. You can expect this Mod to be available shortly after launch.
 

CROSSPLAY CO-OP

Piranha Games has implemented a Co-op Crossplay system that allows players to share IDs and add friends across all digital storefronts and Platforms. However, on specific platforms, you can also use the native friend's list and invite systems to connect for Co-op.  You can even use a mix of the 2 invite systems to connect natively with friends of the same platform as well as players on other platforms and enjoy co-op gaming. Presently, however, we are aware of an issue with Steam's native co-op feature. We are working on finding a solution and will patch the game in the coming weeks to address this.  In the meantime, you can use MW5's own co-op invite functionality. 
 

MODS and MODDING

On the topic of mods for MW5. It is advisable best to wait until your favorite Mod is marked as compatible with the latest update and the DLC before installing.  We will be working closely with our mod-building community, providing them support and a direct line of communication with devs and each other in the Modding channel on the MechWarrior Discord server at Join the MechWarrior: MW5Mercs & MWO Discord Server!

OTHER

Have an issue you don't see here? You can always email support@mw5mercs.com.
 

We will be keeping this post on mw5mercs.com up to date with information over the coming week so be sure to check back to make sure you have the latest intel.
See you in the Inner Sphere Mercenary,
The MechWarrior 5 Team.

notes.title: MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries Price Dates and Features
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999092/8e1ceefb869da291d835ce631e4b81d8f5e172d2.jpg

Today we are excited to share key product details for MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries and Heroes of the Inner Sphere DLC.
NEW TRAILER

 ANNOUNCE TRAILER

LAUNCH DATE

 May 27th
PRICE
 MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries $29.99 USD
 Heroes of the Inner Sphere DLC $19.99 USD

CO-OP AND DLC COMPATIBILITY

 MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries and Heroes of the Inner Sphere DLC will be crossplay compatible for all platforms.
 DLC Co-op compatibility. DLC owners can host and play DLC content with players who do not own the DLC.

MASSIVE UPDATE
MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries Year One update releases May 27th bringing key improvements and new features

 Platform Changes

 Cross-Play on all systems
 Force feedback adds to the immersion of piloting a 'Mech

 Campaign Changes

 Campaign Tutorial is now optional
 Campaign Story has a new beginning

 Gameplay Changes

 Infantry are now present throughout the game 
 Full 360 LOS radar. (Full 360 non-LOS radar is possible with BAP which comes with DLC)
 AI now uses Jump jets in combat
 More extreme conditions such as dense fog. Extreme weather now affects sensors
 Salvage crates with additional rewards or supplies can now be obtained by exploring the map
 More variety and challenge
 Rebalancing of difficulty and economy
 Audio enhancements and recalibration
 Explore a variety of new bases and garrisons

 UI Changes

 Track your encounters and identify where to hunt down desired ‘Mechs
 Keep tabs when borders change or when new tech becomes available
 Instant Action - Previously selected mechs and pilots are restored next time you play
 Apply paint schemes to your entire unit quickly

...along with many more small QoL and bug fixes.

HEROES OF THE INNER SPHERE DLC 

New Career Mode - Start a career from scratch in any of the great houses or import your progress from the original Campaign. Completely rebalanced so you can explore the Inner Sphere and build your merc company as you please. Expanded Inner Sphere Map that includes 61 total warzones (+18), 34 Industrial Hubs, and 55 quest lines (+11).

Career Paths - Visit Cantinas to pick up jobs from the Inner Sphere's shadiest characters. Complete 5 different job types to unlock career path rewards including powerful and unique upgrades that tweak the properties of your mechs. Career paths work in both Campaign and Career mode!

New ‘Mechs - 7 new 'Mech chassis: Corsair, Vulcan, Charger, Hatamoto-Chi, Dervish, Champion, and Marauder II and Adds 50 new variants including new variants for existing chassis

New Missions - Hunt down 7 new heroes and their hero ‘Mechs in Hero Quests.

New Procedural Mission type - Beachhead: clear the landing zone for a full planetary invasion while disrupting communications and avoiding artillery strikes

New Biome - ExtraSolar Moon with Hazardous Atmosphere Garrisons

Artillery and Airstrikes - Avoid enemy airstrikes, call in air support to deliver devastating bombardments, or use TAG/NARC on specific enemies for precision airstrikes

New Equipment
ECM, EWECM - an Electronic Counter Measure creates a distortion bubble that jams opponents' sensors and HUD and reduces their ability to detect you or target effectively. Use counter mode to disable an enemy's ECM. 
BAP, EWAP - an active probe that allows sensors to detect hidden enemies regardless of line of sight
MASC, Supercharger - gives mechs a short duration but incredibly powerful mobility boost.

New Weapons - Chem Lasers, Short Burst Lasers, Mech Rifles, and Stream SRMs

Plus New music tracks set a more diverse and epic tone to the game.

Wishlist today!
